title: SINAI Launches Utility Automation, Turning Utility Bills into Audit-Ready Emissions Data Across Scopes 1, 2, and 3
summary: SINAI introduces Utility Automation, enabling enterprises to automate utility data collection, strengthen compliance readiness, and focus on decarbonization action.
